integrity: Exact analytic second-variation proof and independently executed finite Fourier/checker tests; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Planar origin-symmetric C2 positive-curvature bodies; only local in C2 around disk, not global for q in (4,5). The local q=5 endpoint is proved to fail. No explicit neighborhood radius; earlier Xu–Yang complete text inaccessible, so historical-priority risk remains.
title: Critical fifth-moment failure of local dual Brunn–Minkowski concavity near the disk
